The central element is a weathered, cylindrical post (appearing to be concrete or painted metal) with a complex, somewhat distorted mounting bracket at the top. Two blue rectangular street signs extend from the post. The text on the signs is illegible gibberish, resembling alien script or corrupted characters rather than standard typography. A traffic light housing is partially visible at the very top, appearing structurally fused or melted into the post.
